faqs.q: What is the Use of Microsoft Fabric?
a: A comprehensive data platform that unifies analytics, processing, and storage into a single ecosystem is offered by Microsoft Fabric services. Businesses can more effectively manage large data, carry out advanced analytics, and create machine learning models thanks to its unified capabilities.

faqs.q: Difference Between Microsoft Fabric and Azure SQL
a: Azure SQL is a specialised managed relational database service within Azure that focuses on SQL-based data management, whereas Microsoft Fabric is a more comprehensive platform that combines services like Azure Synapse Analytics, Databricks, and Power BI for end-to-end data and BI solutions.

faqs.q: Is Microsoft Fabric Part of Azure?
a: Indeed. Because Microsoft Fabric services are integrated seamlessly with Azure's cloud infrastructure, they are developed within the Azure ecosystem. This allows companies to take use of Azure's enterprise-grade security, scalability, and flexibility while utilising Microsoft Fabric consulting services for deployment.

faqs.q: Why is There So Much Excitement Around Microsoft Fabric?
a: Microsoft Fabric is becoming more and more popular because of its potential to revolutionise data management. Organisations can deliver insights more quickly, unlock machine learning, and generate more intelligent business intelligence by integrating data engineering, analytics, AI, and BI into a single platform.
